# Archived OpenClaw workflows

These YAML files come from OpenClaw 2.0 (`v2026.8.1`). They need OpenClaw org runners, a GitHub App, CodeQL enablement, and private secrets this personal fork does not have.

They are **not** loaded by GitHub Actions (only `.github/workflows/` is). The live check for this repo is `../workflows/nimbus.yml`.

To restore a workflow on a future OpenClaw-org checkout, move the file back to `.github/workflows/`.
